svg.title: Brewer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as brewer, wearing an apron and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A domed brewing kettle has a short upper neck, straight body and clearly projecting low outlet tap. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
